jahaan.role: Writer, Director, Editor, and Sound Post Production.
jahaan.logline: During a smoke break, a man retreats into magical memories where he is transported to an impressionistic dimension of colors and patterns. He pursues a mysterious yet familiar figure.
jahaan.approach: Jahaan is a story about culture, and the pursuit of identity. I treated it as a study of visual and surrealist storytelling, where the approach was to communicate beyond the surface and challenge the film form.
jahaan.label: WATCH THE FILM

sugar.role: Writer, Director, Editor, and Sound Post Production.
sugar.logline: One quiet morning at a bar, Adrian Catherine Shaw is visited by her future self and told she must stop her friend, Ryan, the waiter, from getting fired or risk losing her future. As the two versions of Adrian work together, they face their own struggles and differences.
sugar.approach: I have always been interested in films that use stylised storytelling. “Two Packets of Sugar, Trust Me.” is an attempt to tell an intimate story of self-reflection in a similarly elevated style.
sugar.label: WATCH THE FILM

roots.role: Co-Writer, Director, Editor, and Sound Post Production.
roots.logline: The true story of Monal Malhotra, an Indian chef in 90s Bahrain who was tasked with cooking for an all-Indian function while only specializing in European cuisine. The story follows his journey through Bahrain as he learns about Indian cuisine and reconnects with his culture.
roots.approach: As someone who is interested in narratives pertaining to identity and culture, Chef Monal Malhotra’s story really resonated with me. Interconnecting the story between the modern day and the 90s was both exciting and daunting given the small scale, run-and-gun nature of the production.
roots.label: WATCH THE FILM

guestroom.role: Co-Writer, Art Director, and Assembly Editor.
guestroom.logline: When a group of strange salesmen arrive at his doorstep with shiny replacements for his home, an ordinary man slowly realizes that the products, and promises they offer, are much more sinister than they appear.
guestroom.approach: Socio-political commentary and analysis is one of the prime ways that filmmaking can engage in important dialog. The Guest Room is about the unfeeling nature of capitalism and how it has adverse effects on people on a micro and macro scale.
guestroom.label: WATCH THE TRAILER

tilldeath.logline: A comedy romance that I co-wrote for my senior year thesis.
tilldeath.approach: Till Death Do Us Part is a dissection of relationships and the complexity of opposing natures in the context of love. While the film’s approach is absurdist, there is a sincerity at the core which drives it.
tilldeath.label: WATCH THE FILM

cuban.role: Writer, Director, Editor, and Sound Post Production.
cuban.logline: Nicky and Patrick are two young and aspiring musicians. After another unsuccessful all-nighter, Nicky begins to have doubts about his pursuit of music. While trying to make coffee, and under the influence of an unidentified laced joint, Nicky and Patrick discover the innate rhythm of the world and the meaning of life.
cuban.approach: Artists tend to struggle quite a bit with imposter syndrome. Within this story, both the protagonists, Nicky and Patrick act as the personifications of self-doubt and belief. Using comedy as a medium of expression, the short film tells the story of aspiring artists.
cuban.label: WATCH THE FILM
